pundit.name: Landon Donovan
pundit.take:
**I think you've got to admire 'Ghost Pepper' Devin's courage—taking a chance on Haiti and still managing to stay in second place, bless his heart.** But when you see him betting on Norway against 'The Backpass Assassin' Gayden's England, you have to wonder if he has some secret insight the rest of us just aren't privy to, or if he's just having a prolonged conversation with fantasy. Look, England is England, with their perennial promise and potential to stumble, but you can't ignore their world-class quality against a Norway side that only occasionally flashes brilliance.

I get why Devin's optimistic; he did just snag 13 points from Spain's win over Belgium, and that can give you a false sense of security. However, when 'The Backpass Assassin' rolls out a Tier 1 team like England and still finds himself languishing in the standings, it's more like watching someone untangle themselves from their own net than execute a perfect backpass. So, with absurd confidence and very little to back it up, I'm calling this one for Gayden. England will likely overpower Norway with the kind of performance that explains why Gayden still has hope, even from the depths of fourth place.
